encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: καὶ τοὺς ἁλιέας εἰς τὸ βάραθρον ἐμβαλῶ.
τριχίδια καὶ σηπίδια καὶ φρυκτούς τινας.
Β. οὗτος πρότερον κεφαλὴν εἰ λάβοι θύννου,

div.note: Athenaeus 7, 302 f Ἄλεξις ἐν Ὀδυσσεῖ ὑφαίνοντι καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν τοῦ θύννου ἐπαινῶν φησιν κτλ.

1. ἁλιέας δὲ et ἐμβάλω A. 2. γὰρ ὀψάρια θηρῶσί Herwerd. Nov. add. crit. 31. 3. σηπίδια] σικχηπίδια A. 4. κεφαλὴν A] κεφάλαιον Mein. λάβοι θύννου A] θύννου λάβοι Erfurdt. κεφαλήν τιν' εἰ λάβοι θύμου Dobr. 5. ἐγχέλεια hic etiam A. θύννας A.

1. Arist. Eq. 1362 contulit Meinekius. — loquuntur duo, quorum alter cetarios sibi nihil nisi viles pisces vendere queritur, alter spectatoribus vel tertiae fortasse personae hunc ipsum, nunc divitem, antea pauperem, olim si vilissimos cibos emisset, Croesi alicuius epulas eas putasse indicat. quae cum ita sint, mirum est pro vilissimo cibo commemorari θύννου κεφαλήν (cf. Calliae 3), cum praesertim sequatur ἐνόμιζε θύννους ἔχειν. quapropter Dobr. Adv. II 318 θύμου: sed quid est θύμου κεφαλή? fortasse scribendum κεφάλαιον εἰ λάβοι κυνός, τοῦ θαλαττίου δηλονότι, cuius ὑπογάστρια (Archestr. Ath. 7, 310c) et οὐραῖα (Mnesim. 4, 36. Menand. 289 Mein.) laudantur, sed ita ut Archestratus vulgus ea aspernari dicat. ac κεφάλαιον fortasse contemptissimum erat.
